_help: How long the app waits after you stop talking before deciding your turn is over (milliseconds). Shorter = the prospect answers sooner but may cut you off when you pause to think. The wait depends on how you stopped: finished_ms if it ended with a question mark or full stop, unfinished_ms if you stopped on a word like 'and', 'the' or 'so' (you're probably still thinking), guessing_ms while the browser is still working out your last words, normal_ms otherwise.
